subject.title: Group reply pipeline silently drops agent-generated payload between turn completion and Telegram sendMessage

question: Should OpenClaw recover substantive generated finals that miss message(action=send), or keep message_tool_only strictly private with diagnostics only?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally keep message_tool_only finals private, while the open successor PR proposes guarded default recovery; automation cannot choose that privacy/delivery tradeoff.

options.title: Review the successor recovery PR
options.body: Resolve the current successor PR conflicts and review it as the canonical guarded-retry direction for stranded substantive finals.

options.title: Keep private-by-default behavior
options.body: If privacy is the product priority, close or narrow recovery work after adding a clear operator diagnostic path and documentation.

options.title: Require a fresh Telegram repro first
options.body: Ask for current-main live Telegram proof of the original automatic group drop before expanding beyond the already tracked stranded-final class.

recommendation.title: Review the successor recovery PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the current successor PR conflicts and review it as the canonical guarded-retry direction for stranded substantive finals.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current successor PR and have the freshest evidence for the remaining recovery design.
